title: Right tensor-shift square on unit tensor generators
statement: Under the prime, coefficient, isomorphism, good-complex and normalized reindexing hypotheses of [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models] and [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization], let SY and SX satisfy [def-pod-completion-reindex-shifts]. For every quotient n, bidegree (p,q), integer shift r, pro-etale object U of X, and original sections x,y of the reindexed second-shifted inputs, the two paths in the right tensor-shift square, precomposed with the inverse tensor comparison, agree on the total tensor of the unit reduction generators 1 tensor x and 1 tensor y. The second-slot formula uses the common unit sign (-1)^(pr). This is an equality of section values in the specified total degree, not yet equality of tower morphisms.

proof.text: Apply D.QuotientGenerators with coefficient 1, using preservation of 1 by the ring map. Then T.InverseGenerators sends the input unit total tensor to its Y counterpart. SY.rightTower and T.Generators give (-1)^(pr) times the tensor at bidegree (p,q+r); the component of T is additive, so the sign commutes with it. The finite tensor map API computes the other path because the termwise reindexing/shift comparison has identity degree components. SX.Generators gives the same output. Transport along (p+q)+r=p+(q+r) using dependent congruence, and conclude equality.

theorem podTensorShift_strictTowerRightGenerator
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D) (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y) (SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X)
    (hSY : SY.Generators l E) (hSX : SX.Generators l E)
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) (r : ℤ)
    [(isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).Additive]
    (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (p q : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).obj P.obj).X p).val.obj U))
    (y : ((((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).obj (Q.obj⟦r⟧)).X q).val.obj U)) :
    let PX := (podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P
    let QX := (podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q
    let xX := unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E X n.unop (PX.obj.X p) U 1 x
    (((T.tower P Q).hom.app n).f ((p+q)+r)).val.app U
      ((((SY.rightTower P Q r).hom.app n).f (p+q)).val.app
        (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U.unop))
        (((((T.tower P ⟨Q.obj⟦r⟧, SY.good Q r⟩).inv.app n).f (p+q)).val.app U)
          (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E X n.unop
            PX.obj ((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).obj (Q.obj⟦r⟧)) p q U
            xX (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E X n.unop _ U 1 y)))) =
      (((SX.rightTower PX QX r).hom.app n).f (p+q)).val.app U
        ((((integralOperationsTensorLevel l E X n.unop).map
          (X := (PX.obj, (isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).obj (Q.obj⟦r⟧)))
          (Y := (PX.obj, QX.obj⟦r⟧))
          (𝟙 PX.obj,
            (((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).commShiftIso r).hom.app Q.obj))).f
              (p+q)).val.app U
          (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E X n.unop
            PX.obj ((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).obj (Q.obj⟦r⟧)) p q U
            xX (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E X n.unop _ U 1 y)))
